<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def glyph(frame,r0,c0):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(''.join('#' if a[r][c]=='B' else ('o' if a[r][c]=='P' else '.') for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def black(g): return tuple(x.replace('o','.') for x in g)
cycles={0:[('#####','#o#o#','#o###','#ooo#','#####'),('#####','o#oo#','o#oo#','o####','oooo#'),
('oo#oo','#####','#o#o#','#####','oo#oo'),('####o','#oo##','#ooo#','##oo#','o####'),
('oo#oo','#####','#ooo#','#ooo#','#####'),('#####','#ooo#','#####','o#o#o','o###o'),
('oo###','oo#o#','#####','#o#oo','###oo')]}
# re-extract cycles 1..4 from the last 4 loop runs? They're not stored. Re-derive from transitions is messy;
# instead recompute membership by re-reading? We only stored cycles[0]. Need cycles 1-4 again.
# But each slot is back at original glyph; re-mapping costs 28 UPs. Do it.
for target in range(1,5):
    c0=15+7*target
    start=glyph(current_frame,52,c0)
    seq=[start]
    for i in range(12):
        action(['UP'])
        g=glyph(current_frame,52,c0)
        seq.append(g)
        if g==start: break
    cycles[target]=seq[:-1]
    if target<4: action(['RIGHT'])
# cursor at slot 4; move to slot 0
action(['LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT'])
def cardglyph(r0,c0):
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(''.join('#' if a[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
cards={'P12':cardglyph(5,23),'P14':cardglyph(5,46),'P22':cardglyph(14,23),'P24':cardglyph(14,46),'P32':cardglyph(23,23),'P34':cardglyph(23,46)}
cur=[glyph(current_frame,52,15+7*i) for i in range(5)]
for i in range(5):
    mem={n:j for n,g in cards.items() if black(g)==black(cycles[i][0]) or any(black(g)==black(c) for c in cycles[i])}
    idx=[j for j,c in enumerate(cycles[i]) if black(c)==black(cards.get('P12'))]
    print('slot',i,'cards in cycle:',[n for n,g in cards.items() if black(g) in [black(c) for c in cycles[i]]])
    print('   current idx:',[j for j,c in enumerate(cycles[i]) if c==cur[i]])
result={'done':True}
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
